budget.label: Most Important — Budget Hearing
budget.title: Budget Hearing
budget.where:
Philadelphia City Council Chambers, Room 400
Fourth Floor, City Hall
Philadelphia, PA
budget.testify: To testify: call 215-686-3407 or email budget@phila.gov by 3 PM on May 5 with your name, position (support/oppose), phone number, and address.
budget.tip_arrive: Arrive early. The session runs all day — the LIFT bill's slot isn't announced in advance.
budget.tip_entry: Getting in: Enter at the northeast corner of City Hall (Market & Broad, near the Masonic Temple). Bring a government-issued ID to pass through security.
budget.tip_register: Pre-register to testify using the contact info above — it takes 2 minutes and is the official requirement for public hearings. When you arrive, sign in at the booklet at the Room 400 entrance with your name and Bill No. 251026.
budget.tip_testify: Testify: You have 2 minutes (~300 words). Lead with your personal story — how this affects your work and income. Council responds to people, not statistics.
budget.tip_close: Finish strong: End with “That concludes my testimony.”
budget.tip_bring: Bring: Your ID, notes, water, and a pen.
